LOOK: Commuters board a free ride service provided by the Manila City Government at a jeepney terminal along Agoncillo Street in Ermita, Manila, on March 30.

A total of 1,400 public utility jeepneys (PUJs) have been deployed under the “Libreng Sakay” program, led by Manila Mayor Francisco Isko Moreno Domagoso, to offer free transportation while helping drivers cope with rising fuel prices and the ongoing transport strike. The program runs from March 30 to April 2 and will resume from April 6 to April 8. | 📸: Niño Jesus Orbeta, Philippine Daily Inquirer

Migrant workers’ rights advocates staged a picket protest outside the Department of Migrant Workers in Mandaluyong City on Monday, March 30, to denounce what they described as the government’s alleged neglect of distressed overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) in the Middle East.

The protesters called on authorities to strengthen assistance, protection, and repatriation efforts for migrant workers facing abuse, displacement, and other forms of crises abroad. 

📸: Santi San Juan/MB

Ayon sa ulat ng Raxabago Police Station PS-1 ng Manila Police District, kinilala ang biktima na si alyas Roxette, may-ari ng mga sasakyan at residente sa lugar.

Batay sa paunang imbestigasyon, napansin na lamang umano ng biktima na nasusunog na ang kanyang mga sasakyan kaya agad siyang humingi ng tulong sa barangay at sa Bureau of Fire Protection. | RH 29 @boy_gonzales, DZRH News
